document.about: NIOSH Manual of Analytical Methods, Method 7400 (Asbestos and other fibers by PCM), Issue 3, 2019. Page 21 draws the Walton-Beckett graticule as a picture, its fibres labelled by size (`20×3`, `10×3`, `5×5/3`) and numbered in circles; an OCR engine reads the labels in it.

notes: The stored reading is the built-in engine's (PP-OCRv6 small) of the picture's crop: `fdoc dev render-routed --ocr-regions --stored-resolution`, then `fdoc ocr --models`.

checks.issue: The labels read by OCR in the picture were read with the page's text, each a paragraph of its own.
As above: no label stands as a paragraph.
